title: Sliver opacity starts one frame late

evidence.additional_evidence: At frame 5 / 80 ms Incular equals Flutter's frame-4 opacity; both reach 0.25 at frame 26.
evidence.impact: The visible opacity trajectory lags Flutter's by one frame during the fade, then converges to the same target.
evidence.cause: Retained sliver adoption schedules forward_on_next_tick after the current frame's tick; Flutter starts the controller during didUpdateWidget.
evidence.fix_direction: Establish the adopted animation before the first post-update tick so its elapsed timeline matches Flutter.

title: AnimatedDefaultTextStyle has intermittent one-pixel line-box drift

evidence.additional_evidence: Frame 0 matches. Horizontal widths differ by less than 0.00002 px while top and bottom differ by 0.5 px on five intermediate frames; adjacent frames sometimes match.
evidence.impact: A text widget's layout bounds can shift by one logical pixel during a font-size animation and move nearby content.
evidence.cause: Tween progress and text width agree; the observed difference is in line-box metrics at fractional font sizes, likely text-engine metric rounding.
evidence.fix_direction: Compare Flutter and Incular line metrics for the same Inter font sizes and align fractional-size line-box rounding.

title: Implicit layout widgets cannot animate directional geometry

evidence.impact: Callers cannot preserve start/end alignment or insets in RTL layouts through AnimatedContainer, AnimatedPadding, AnimatedAlign, or AnimatedFractionallySizedBox, and cannot interpolate mixed directional and physical geometry.
evidence.cause: Implicit widget setters and tween storage accept concrete Alignment and EdgeInsets values; Incular's separate directional types are not accepted by those APIs.
evidence.fix_direction: Accept Flutter-equivalent geometry enums and interpolate them with direction-aware geometry lerps.

title: Opacity widgets cannot match Flutter's semantic visibility option

evidence.impact: At zero opacity, assistive technology may still announce or navigate Incular child content that Flutter hides by default; callers cannot choose Flutter's alwaysIncludeSemantics behavior.
evidence.cause: Incular opacity is paint-only for semantic exposure and has no always-include flag.
evidence.fix_direction: Add the flag to box and sliver opacity widgets and propagate it into semantics projection, defaulting to Flutter's false behavior.

title: AnimatedPhysicalModel has no circular shape option

evidence.impact: Callers cannot create Flutter's circular physical model or match its clip and shadow silhouette.
evidence.cause: The Incular widget models corner radii but has no rectangle/circle shape field.
evidence.fix_direction: Add shape to the widget and renderer-neutral physical-model descriptor, then support the matching paint and clip behavior.

evidence.impact: Callers cannot configure inherited paragraph wrapping, truncation, alignment, or line-height behavior through Incular's animated style widget.
evidence.cause: Incular's AnimatedDefaultTextStyle stores only TextStyle, child, and timing.
evidence.fix_direction: Add Flutter's paragraph options to AnimatedDefaultTextStyle and pass them through to the default-style scope.
